title: omnicrawl provider plans
description: The plans a provider publishes limits for, beside its policy.json (Omnicrawl\Policy\Plans). The default is the most restrictive plan, and policy.json's own rateLimits and concurrency are the default plan's. A plan's rateLimits and concurrency replace the policy's; rights, requirements and terms stay the provider's. Shaped to become a "plans" member of omnisense/contracts' usage-policy schema unchanged.

default.description: The plan that applies when the site names none: the free or most restrictive one.

source.description: Where the provider publishes the plan's limits.
